# Copilot instructions for Lost Memory Park

- Read `/AGENTS.md` and `/AI_HANDOFF.md` before editing.
- The only source of truth is `/source`; root `/index.html` is generated by `cd source && npm run release:pages`.
- Keep the game Canvas 2D, non-pixel, desktop/mobile, stable-camera, pure movement platformer.
- Do not restore dash, attacks, anchors, rewind, random portals, boss skips, near-miss combo, or stage heat.
- Preserve 4 chapters × 6 progressive normal rooms and the learn/practice/test/finish structure in each room.
- Add or update colocated Vitest tests for gameplay changes.
- Run `npm test`, `npm run build`, and `npm run check:release` before completion.
- Update `CHANGELOG.md`, relevant docs, `AI_HANDOFF.md`, and `docs/project-state.json` when behavior changes.
- Never modify repositories or data belonging to the AMA organization. The only release target is `liuzhanrui30-boop/lost-memory-park`.
